intro: InSight landed in Elysium Planitia on November 26, 2018 — the first geophysical observatory on Mars. The mission listened for marsquakes with the SEIS seismometer for four years, recording over 1,300 quakes that revealed the planet's core, mantle, and crust in unprecedented detail. The mole drill (HP³) failed to bury itself, but SEIS more than made up for the disappointment. Mission ended December 2022 when dust accumulation killed the solar panels.
